name: Work Glasses Answers
description: Ask about your job out loud; see a 3-line answer from your team's docs, with the source.

permissions.description: Hear your question only after you tap or press the button.
On camera glasses, take one photo of what you're looking at when you ask. This app does not keep it.

hardwareRequirements.description: Shows the 3-line answer. Without a display, the answer is spoken.
Your spoken question (phone mic is used if the glasses have none).
Press to ask, long-press to clear.
